profile.reading: This Data4 facility, coded MAD01, is located at Avenida de la Industria 15, 28108 Alcobendas, Spain, part of the operator own 2 building Madrid campus. The operator own page gives this building a capacity of 50 MW across approximately 4 hectares. The full Madrid campus totals 10.7 hectares and 100 MW combined across both buildings, MAD01 and MAD02. Data4 is a data center operator founded in 2006 and headquartered in Paris, France, operating campuses in France, Italy, Spain, Poland, Germany, and Greece. Data4 was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Paris, France, described in the company own 2019-era published materials as controlled by AXA, the French insurance and asset-management group, though the specific AXA entity and any co-investors could not be independently confirmed this session. Data4 own site describes a six-country European footprint spanning France, Italy, Spain, Poland, Germany, and Greece, totaling roughly ten campuses, 1.5 gigawatts of capacity, and 165,000 square meters of IT space group-wide. This record marks the broader MAD1 campus area at Alcobendas, distinct from the three individual numbered buildings, MAD1-DC01 through MAD1-DC03, mapped separately elsewhere in this dataset. Alcobendas sits in the northern Madrid metropolitan area, a well-established business and technology corridor that has attracted corporate back-office and telecom infrastructure investment for decades. Data4 has operated in Spain since expanding beyond its French home market, and Madrid two-site presence, this Alcobendas MAD1 campus and the newer, larger MAD2 site in San Agustín del Guadalix, reflects a broader pattern across Data4 European portfolio of pairing an established first campus with a second, larger-capacity site once local demand justifies the additional investment, a pattern also seen in Data4 Milan market documented elsewhere in this dataset under the Data4 Italia operator name.
